title: Yellow Glazed Egyptian Steak Tagine
description: A funky and snappy Egyptian dish featuring fillet of steak, glaze, and cooked in a claypot, perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, mix together the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper
In a large claypot, heat the olive oil over medium heat
Add the chopped onion to the claypot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the claypot and cook for an additional 1 minute
Add the cubed steak to the claypot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Add the cumin mixture to the claypot and stir to combine
Pour the yellow glaze over the steak and onions in the claypot
Cover the claypot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the steak is cooked to desired doneness
